text:
jordan (AE): CivicBank wants a 2-week private POC next month. RFP bullets: BYO KMS, preserve client IP for their SIEM, no direct internet egress from our nodes, and can we provide a firewall snippet + IAM trust they can paste? Also they asked for a Dedicated pricing estimate for 100 rps and burst to 300.

sam (Solutions Eng): High level: two topology options. 1) PrivateLink interface endpoints into their VPC + our managed connector in their account (better isolation, minimal route exposure). 2) Transit VPC with VPC peering to our VPCs (fewer endpoints but route table exposure). Both can be configured to prevent internet egress.

rita (NetOps): Practical constraints: many managed LB vendors SNAT egress; if they deploy our connector behind their ALB, that ALB may SNAT and break srcIP preservation. We need to know their LB type.

kevin (Security): For BYO KMS we need ARN + cross-account role: customer creates a key policy allowing our service principal assume-role access limited to Encrypt/Decrypt. We can provide a templated trust policy. Note: we don't do HSM attestation inside the runtime; can offer KMS-only envelope encryption.

mike (Infra): Egress control options: A) Terminate outbound at their NAT with strict SGs (requires no SNAT on path). B) Force egress into a customer-managed proxy via IPsec tunnel (we can establish and preserve TCP src IP across the tunnel). C) Reject all internet routes and only allow traffic to their SIEM collector/management IPs.

jordan (AE): They also asked about audited network flows for compliance. Can we supply flow logs + mapping to requests?

sam (Solutions Eng): We can enable VPC flow logs for the connector subnets and export to their S3/CloudWatch. For request-level mapping we can emit x-forwarded-for and a request id in logs so they can correlate.

rita (NetOps): Quick firewall snippet for them to paste: ```# Allow from app subnets to interface endpoint
ALLOWED_PORTS="443 514" # 514 for syslog optional
ALLOW_SRC=10.20.0.0/16
ALLOW_DST=vpce-0123456789abcdef.us-east-1.vpce
iptables -A FORWARD -s $ALLOW_SRC -d $ALLOW_DST -p tcp --dport 443 -j ACCEPT
# Allow IPsec from our public tunnel endpoints if using site-to-site
# Ports: 500/udp, 4500/udp, 50/51 (ESP/AH) - vendor dependent
```

kevin (Security): Add to questionnaire answers: data residency locked to customer's region for private deploy, BYO KMS supported w/ cross-account role & envelope encryption, RBAC via SSO + SCIM provisioning, audit logs retained per contract. I'll draft short Q/A lines.

mike (Infra): Latency note: Dedicated 4xA10G in eu-west with optimized quantized model should be fine for p95 < 250ms at 100 rps if requests are short. Burst to 300 rps will need pre-warmed burst capacity or autoscale; for a POC recommend a small reserved pool + burst cap. Pricing: POC month reserved + per-request usage. I'll give numbers offline.

jordan (AE): CivicBank also wants a checklist for the PrivateLink approach (they prefer interface endpoints). Sam/Rita — can you list the deliverables we need to hand them?

sam (Solutions Eng): Deliverables for PrivateLink: 1) VPCE DNS names and interface endpoint SGs to allow. 2) Exact management CIDRs and IPs for outbound management connections (we'll provide). 3) IAM trust policy + KMS key policy snippet. 4) A short runbook for certificate exchange and mTLS between our connector and their app. 5) Firewall snippet (Rita's).

rita (NetOps): Also include a small checklist item: confirm ALB/NGINX SNAT behavior. If SNAT can't be disabled, we must do an IPsec hairpin/HOST-NAT workaround.

kevin (Security): KMS trust policy sample they can paste: ```{
  "Version":"2012-10-17",
  "Statement":[{
    "Effect":"Allow",
    "Principal":{"AWS":"arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/RedwoodServiceAccess"},
    "Action":["kms:Encrypt","kms:Decrypt","kms:GenerateDataKey"],
    "Resource":"*"
  }]
}```(they must scope Resource/Condition in production).

mike (Infra): For zero-egress requirement we must ensure no CRL/OCSP outbound from the runtime. If they require that we need to vendor-bundle cert revocation lists or provide an internal OCSP responder reachable via the private link. Flagging this as a potential blocker.

jordan (AE): Great — can we have the one-pager (checklist + firewall + KMS + pricing ballpark) by EOD? I'll attach to the RFP response.

sam (Solutions Eng): I'll assemble the one-pager with a short diagram and push it here in a couple hours.

rita (NetOps): I'll add a short SNAT detection checklist they can run against their LB and sample curl commands to verify x-forwarded-for. Eg: `curl -sS -D - https://our-vpce.example --header "X-Test: 1"` then check flow logs.

jordan (AE): Thanks team. I'll schedule the technical call for Tue 09:00 CET and include CivicBank netsec. Please mark any legal items in the questionnaire that need signoff.
